How to ban players from your Garry's Mod Server
How to get your (and other players) SteamID - example GMod status row

notes: Garry's Mod is a Source dedicated server (srcds, app 4020), so these are base engine commands, not addon commands - they work with no admin mod installed. Transport is the standard Valve Source RCON protocol; engine code (net_ws.cpp) binds the RCON listener to the SAME port as the game server socket, so RCON is TCP on the game port, 27015 by default, changed with the -port launch argument. rcon_password is a cvar, normally set in garrysmod/cfg/server.cfg; a non-empty value is what enables RCON, there is no separate enable switch. Exact engine usage strings: 'kickid < userid | uniqueid > { message }', 'banid < minutes > < userid | uniqueid > { kick }', 'removeid < slot | uniqueid >'. DISAGREEMENT: some hosting guides publish 'banid DURATION STEAMID REASON' (e.g. supercraft.host) - that is wrong; banid takes no reason, and the optional third argument must be the literal word 'kick' or the banned player stays connected, which is why it is hard-coded here. {duration} is MINUTES and 0 means permanent. The kick reason is deliberately unquoted: kickid takes the rest of the line verbatim, so quotes typed around the message are shown to the player as literal quote characters. Bans are in-memory until 'writeid' is run - it rewrites garrysmod/cfg/banned_user.cfg as lines of the form 'banid 0 STEAM_0:1:12345678' (permanent bans only; timed bans are never written). So a ban that must survive a restart is 'banid ... kick' followed by 'writeid', and an unban is 'removeid ...' followed by 'writeid'. status output was confirmed against a real GMod capture: header '# userid name uniqueid connected ping loss state adr' then rows like '# 78 "DarkLightning321" STEAM_0:0:49333982 43:33 61 0 active'. GMod renders SteamIDs in the STEAM_0 form; the pattern also accepts STEAM_1 because some hosting docs quote that universe digit. Bots print 'BOT' and joining players 'STEAM_ID_PENDING' as uniqueid - both are skipped by linePattern on purpose. No console command sets the MOTD (GMod uses garrysmod/settings/motd.txt or an sv_loadingurl page), so motd is omitted. Addon admin mods (ULX, DarkRP) add their own ulx kick/ban commands; those are NOT recorded here because they are not present on a stock server.
